mr_title: Handle Content-Length in ShallowEtagHeaderFilter more robustly
mr_description:
This commit ensures that setting the Content-Length through
setHeader("Content-Length", x") has the same effect as calling
setContentLength in the ShallowEtagHeaderFilter. It also filters out
Content-Type headers similarly to Content-Length.

expected_issues.title: Content-Type captured by the wrapper is never forwarded to the response
expected_issues.description:
The wrapper now swallows Content-Type (setContentType/setHeader/addHeader store it locally) and never forwards it to the wrapped response, and getContentType() ignores a type already set on the underlying response.

Unlike Content-Length, the Content-Type must reach the real response even when the body is not cached or copyBodyToResponse() is never called (e.g. ShallowEtagHeaderFilter with caching disabled for a request, streaming, or code that inspects the underlying response). With this change the type is only held in a field: responses may be sent without Content-Type, and getContentType() returns null when the type was set on the wrapped response before wrapping. Content-Type should not be intercepted (or must be delegated to super).
